title: A Fascinating Experience
text: Pedro was the perfect guide. He brought the history of the Jewish quarter to life through his storytelling approach. The 3 hours we spent in his company was fascinating. Gracias Pedro. You’ve given us a wonderful insight into this colourful corner of Seville and the tapestry that is Spanish history in general.
author: Natasha_v

title: Outstanding Experience
text: Pedro's tour of the Jewish Quarters was more than a tour, it was an outstanding experience I will never forget. We saw hidden jems most people would not see on other large tours. Pedro tailored the tour for us based on our knowledge of Sevilla and provided us with in-depth historical details, local stories, and intriguing myths. This experience was far beyond what we expected. You can tell Pedro truly loves his city. Next time we are in Sevilla, we will definitely book more experiences with Pedro. I highly recommend him!
